_meanings:
<ab>Ved.</ab> Naming; praised, invoked. {#aBiDA asi Buvanamasi#}
 {#yantAsi DartA#} <ls>Vāj. 22. 3</ls>. {%n.%}
.²1 A name, appellation; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>; {#kusumavasantAdyaBiDaH#} <ls>S. D.</ls>
.²2 A word, sound.
.²3 The literal power or sense of a word, {%denotation%}, one of the three
 powers of a word; {#vAcyo'rTo'BiDayA boDyaH#} <ls>S. D. 2</ls>. “the expressed
 meaning is that which is conveyed to the understanding by the wordʼs denotation”,
 for it is this {#aBiDA#} that conveys to the understanding the meaning
 which belongs to the word by common consent or convention ({#saMketa#})
 (which primarily made it a word at all); {#sa muKyo'rTastatra muKyo yo#}
 {#vyApAro'syABiDocyate#} <ls>K. P. 2</ls>.
founded on a wordʼs denotation or literal meaning.
